0.reason: Thread timers with a callback for the screenshot fire and cancel pair; they have no window and no stable id.

1.reason: Settings panel windows tick while open; a closed panel has no timer.

INPUT_HOOK_THREAD_TIMER_REQUEST_ID.reason: Low level hook stall watchdog every 5 s on the hook thread. The hook thread has its own message loop, so the counted pump never sees it.
INPUT_HOOK_THREAD_TIMER_REQUEST_ID.exception: Twelve wakes a minute on the hook thread; not part of the counted pump.

TIMER.reason: 50 ms tick only while a computer pane session is active.

TIMER_ACCOUNT.reason: Authenticated remote layout sync every 5 s once signed in.
TIMER_ACCOUNT.exception: Twelve wakes a minute by design: server-side layout changes have no push channel. Not armed with account bypass.

TIMER_ACCOUNT_SAVE.reason: Dirty layout push debounce, armed after a change.

TIMER_AI_PACE.reason: Remote provider pace refresh every 15 s normal, 60 s saving, stopped in deep idle.
TIMER_AI_PACE.exception: Four wakes a minute in normal power mode: provider usage freshness.

TIMER_BROWSER_ADOPT.reason: Only while adopting a requested pane, with a deadline.

TIMER_BROWSER_HEALTH.reason: Hung browser window check every 1 s normal, 5 s saving, 30 s deep idle.
TIMER_BROWSER_HEALTH.exception: Sixty wakes a minute in normal power mode: hung-window detection keeps its original 1 s cadence.

TIMER_BROWSER_PLACEHOLDER.reason: One-shot wake at the opening to not-open deadline.

TIMER_BROWSER_URL_POLL.reason: Active browser tab URL check every 250 ms normal, 2 s saving, stopped in deep idle. Armed only with a browser tab shown.
TIMER_BROWSER_URL_POLL.exception: Two hundred forty wakes a minute with a browser tab shown in normal power mode: missed URL notifications.

TIMER_CHAT_AC_DEBOUNCE.reason: One retry for an open autocomplete.

TIMER_CHAT_BENCH.reason: Fixture only: 1 s command heartbeat of the chat bench.

TIMER_CHAT_DICTATION.reason: Dictation state tick while dictation is active.

TIMER_CHAT_FIND.reason: 50 ms tick only while a find job runs.

TIMER_CHAT_FOREGROUND_RETRY.reason: Bounded foreground retry after a user action.

TIMER_CHAT_REFRESH.reason: Active chat status and activity refresh every 750 ms. Hidden or minimized views do no work; stopped in deep idle.
TIMER_CHAT_REFRESH.exception: Eighty wakes a minute with a visible chat in normal power mode: working-status latency.

TIMER_CHAT_SCROLLBAR.reason: 50 ms fade tick only while the scrollbar is visible.

TIMER_CHAT_SEL_SCROLL.reason: 50 ms tick only during a selection drag. Shares id 36 with TIMER_SSH_RECONNECT.

TIMER_CHAT_SEND_VERIFY.reason: Bounded verification and retry sequence after a send.

TIMER_CHAT_WORKING.reason: 250 ms working indicator, armed only while a chat is working.

TIMER_ETA_REPAINT.reason: Countdown repaint every 15 s. Armed only while an ETA exists.
TIMER_ETA_REPAINT.exception: Four wakes a minute while an ETA is shown.

TIMER_FONT_SYNC.reason: 150 ms tick only while an incremental font sync runs.

TIMER_INBOX_PUBLISH.reason: One-shot publish debounce after a mutation.

TIMER_INBOX_REFRESH.reason: Live model, relative time and ETA refresh every 1 s. Armed only for the Inbox view or a starred workspace.
TIMER_INBOX_REFRESH.exception: Sixty wakes a minute while the Inbox or a starred workspace is shown.

TIMER_NAME_POLL.reason: Session title, cwd and process reconciliation every 30 s in normal mode, 60 s in saving and deep idle.
TIMER_NAME_POLL.exception: Two wakes a minute by design: no event source covers console-only tools and missed hooks.

TIMER_POWER_IDLE.reason: Global input and power re-evaluation every 30 s.
TIMER_POWER_IDLE.exception: Two wakes a minute by design: deep idle needs a clock to start from.

TIMER_REFOCUS.reason: Bounded focus retry after a user action.

TIMER_REMINDERS.exception: Two wakes a minute by design: a due time needs a clock tick.

TIMER_ROOM.reason: 250 ms re-arm while a room action is pending.

TIMER_ROOM_DISCOVERY.reason: Armed on demand by room discovery work.

TIMER_ROOM_EVIDENCE.reason: Armed on demand by room evidence work.

TIMER_ROOM_UI.reason: Armed on demand by room front end work.

TIMER_SAVE.reason: 500 ms save debounce after a change.

TIMER_SHOT_FOCUS.reason: Bounded screenshot and paste focus handoff.

TIMER_SPINNER.reason: Agent activity animation every 500 ms. Armed only while an agent is active; stopped in deep idle.
TIMER_SPINNER.exception: One hundred twenty wakes a minute while an agent is active.

TIMER_SSH_RECONNECT.reason: 1 s tick only while reconnecting. Shares id 36 with TIMER_CHAT_SEL_SCROLL.

TIMER_STARTUP_SHELL.reason: Startup shell attach; ends with startup.

TIMER_SYSTEM_THEME.reason: System theme fallback poll every 1 s normal, 10 s saving, stopped in deep idle. Not armed for a fixed theme.
TIMER_SYSTEM_THEME.exception: Sixty wakes a minute in normal power mode, only with the System theme.

TIMER_TUNNEL_KEEPER.reason: Process and connection recovery every 2 s normal, 10 s saving, 30 s deep idle.
TIMER_TUNNEL_KEEPER.exception: Thirty wakes a minute in normal power mode: recovery latency is the product behaviour.

TIMER_UPDATE_CHECK.reason: Update check tick every 30 s: reads the staged release, starts the release check when its own interval is due, and retries failed server key setup.
TIMER_UPDATE_CHECK.exception: Two wakes a minute by design: the release check and the key setup retry both need a clock tick.

TIMER_VISIT_DWELL.reason: One-shot dwell timer for the frequent-visit tracker.

TIMER_VOICE_MANUAL.reason: Armed only for a manual voice turn.

TIMER_VOICE_POLL.reason: 150 ms tick only while speech plays.

TIMER_VPS_CAPACITY.reason: Remote inventory refresh every 15 s normal, 60 s saving, stopped in deep idle.
TIMER_VPS_CAPACITY.exception: Four wakes a minute in normal power mode: remote inventory freshness.

selection_offer_timer.reason: One-shot selection offer delay on its own child window.

chat_find_ui.zig:jump.reason: Fetches the page around a find hit when the user jumps to it.

chat_render.zig:chatReplyResolve.reason: Fetches the quoted message when the user opens a reply.

chat_render.zig:chatScrollBy.reason: Fetches older history when the user scrolls above the loaded range.

chat_send.zig:chatMessageSyncFinish.reason: Fetches once after a send completes.

chat_send.zig:chatTmuxSettle.reason: Fetches once after the sent text settles in the session.

chat_session.zig:chatDeferTranscriptLoad.reason: Loads the transcript when a chat tab opens or is switched to.

chat_session.zig:chatFileOnReady.reason: Re-requests the active chat when its live stream revision changes and the live channel is held.

chat_session.zig:chatFileRequest.reason: Plain wrapper every other caller goes through; it has no trigger of its own.

chat_session.zig:chatResync.reason: Re-fetches when the user asks for a resync.

chat_session.zig:chatVoiceReplySource.reason: Fetches the reply text a voice turn reads out.

chat_session.zig:chatWarmOftenUsed.reason: Keeps the most recently viewed server chats that are not active warm; runs on the chat refresh tick.

chat_session.zig:refreshChatBlockCache.reason: Requests the active chat history before the block cache is rebuilt; runs on the refresh tick and on view changes.
